title: Silent h
explanation: In Spanish, the letter h is usually written but not pronounced. Read hola as ola and hambre as ambre. The spelling still keeps h.

title: Stable Spanish vowels
explanation: Spanish vowels are stable in simple words. The vowel sound in hola, adiós, gracias, and por favor stays clear and short.

title: Greetings by time of day
explanation: Use buenos días in the morning, buenas tardes in the afternoon, and buenas noches in the evening or at night. Hola works at any time.
